sentiment.rationale: Full-year revenue guidance was narrowed but not raised (range $10.96B-$11.05B, representing 4% growth vs prior year), and EPS guidance was raised slightly from $12.77-$12.97 to $12.92-$13.02, but this is a modest improvement from a low base. More importantly, Q4 revenue guidance is negative 3% to negative 1% versus last year, and management explicitly stated that 'the negatives will outweigh the positives' for operating margin in 2026, citing a full year of increased tariffs and removal of de minimis provision. The CEO transition and acknowledged demand softening post-Thanksgiving further weigh on the outlook. The overall forward guidance is effectively reduced relative to prior expectations, and management's language is cautious and defensive.

summary.revenue: Q3 revenue $2.6 billion, up 7% on both reported and constant currency basis. Americas revenue down 2%, U.S. down 3%, China Mainland up 46%, Rest of World up 19%.
summary.eps: Q3 diluted EPS $2.59, down from $2.87 a year ago.
summary.guidance: Full-year revenue $10.96B-$11.05B (4% growth); Q4 revenue $3.5B-$3.59B (negative 3% to negative 1% vs last year); full-year diluted EPS $12.92-$13.02 (down from $14.64 in 2024); Q4 EPS $4.66-$4.76 (vs $6.14 a year ago).
summary.margin: Q3 gross margin 55.6%, down 290 bps; full-year gross margin expected to decrease ~270 bps; Q4 gross margin expected to decrease ~580 bps; full-year operating margin expected to decrease ~390 bps.
key_risks: Tariffs and removal of de minimis provision causing significant margin pressure (410 bps in Q4 alone).
U.S. demand softening post-Thanksgiving, reflected in Q4 guidance.
Elevated markdowns: 90 bps increase in Q3, 100 bps expected in Q4.
Full-year 2026 operating margin expected to be under pressure, with negatives outweighing positives.
Inventory up 11% ($2B), with dollar growth outpacing units due to tariffs and FX.
key_opportunities: China Mainland revenue growth of 46% in Q3, now expected at or above high end of 20%-25% annual growth.
International momentum: Rest of World up 19% in constant currency.
Product innovation pipeline: new style penetration targeted at 35% for spring 2026.
Improved speed to market: chase capabilities for replenishment in 6-8 weeks.
Digital revenue up 13%, record Black Friday e-commerce sales.
Strong balance sheet with $1B cash and no debt, $1.6B share repurchase authorization.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly hedged forward language, stating 'it is fair to assume that the negatives will outweigh the positives' for 2026 operating margin and acknowledging 'some pullback in demand post Thanksgiving' which was reflected in guidance.
